hero_pill: 100% Offline · Private Data on Your Machine
hero_lead: A fast, native Windows desktop app for students, schedules, attendance, receipts, and accounting.
f_title: Everything you need to run your school
f_desc: Practical tools built to eliminate paper chaos and manual spreadsheet errors.
f1_desc: Instant roll call for each group and ready-to-print official attendance sheets.
f2_desc: Smart class scheduling with automated room and teacher conflict prevention.
f3_desc: Student fee receipts, payroll cycles, teacher wages, and accurate cash balance.
f4_desc: Batch import students and teachers in seconds using pre-formatted Excel templates.
f5_desc: Automated encrypted cloud backups to restore your data seamlessly when changing computers.
f6_desc: Detailed income analysis by grade/teacher and complete audit trail with Excel export.

faq_q1: Is an active Internet connection required?
faq_a1: No. Acadex operates 100% offline. Network access is only required for optional cloud backup and updates.
faq_q2: Where is our school data stored?
faq_a2: Directly on your local computer hard drive in complete privacy, never exposed to shared third-party servers.
faq_a3: No. It is a one-time purchase ({p1} / {p2} / {p3}) with no subscription.
faq_q4: Can I upgrade my plan later?
faq_a4: Yes. Simply enter a new activation code: features unlock immediately with all your data untouched.
cta_desc: A single lightweight Windows installer configures the app and database in under a minute.
footer_copy: Your data securely on your computer.

faq_a6: In Tunisia: cash or D17 (the Tunisian Post payment app). Payment is made once; installments are not offered. Nothing is charged when you order: we call you first to confirm.
terms_title: Before you buy: what to know
terms1_d: The download is free, but the app opens on the activation screen: without a code it cannot be used.
terms2_d: Watch the demo video at the top of the page, or ask for a live demo on WhatsApp or by phone. No payment when you order.
terms3_d: Once the activation code has been delivered, the licence is not refunded. Take the time to see the demo before you decide.
faq_q7: Can I try Acadex before paying?
faq_a7: There is no trial period: without an activation code the app stays on the activation screen. The demo is free: the video on this page shows the app running, and we present it live on request (WhatsApp or phone). Once the activation code has been delivered, the licence is not refunded.
seg_title: Built for your kind of institution
seg_school_1: Tuition fees and receipts: every payment produces a printable receipt, and you see who still has to pay.
seg_school_2: Timetables without clashes: the app warns when a teacher or a room is already taken.
seg_school_3: Attendance at every session: roll call in class, and attendance sheets you can print.
seg_center_1: Teacher pay by percentage: each teacher's share is worked out from the payments collected for their groups.
seg_center_2: Groups, payments and receipts: students are organised by group, and every payment collected produces a receipt.
seg_center_3: Sessions and rooms: a weekly plan of sessions, room by room, and an attendance sheet per group.
data_desc: Everything stays on your computer, with backups for the day it breaks down.
data1_d: The school's data is saved on your computer's disk. Nothing leaves the machine, except the cloud backup when your pack includes it.
data2_d: A daily automatic backup set in the settings (the last 7 are kept), manual backups whenever you want, and a one-click restore.
data3_t: Cloud backup with Plus and Complet
data3_d: An encrypted copy is sent to the cloud automatically, so you can restore your data on another computer.
data4_d: With Plus or Complet, you restore the cloud backup on the new PC. With Essentiel, the backups sit on the same computer: save a copy to a USB key or an external drive regularly. The licence is tied to one PC, so contact us to activate it on the new machine.
